titleEn: One Step Out from Behind Mom!

pages.text: "Why is that boat so full?" Mina ran to the landing. High water had brought moving-day belongings by boat. An unfamiliar monkey child stood beside the bundles.
"I'd like to play with that child." Mina spoke softly, holding Mom's hand. But when the monkey looked over, Mina hid behind Mom. Their heart pounded, and their feet stuck still.
"Want to play? I'm Biju." Mina did not move behind Mom. 'I want to... but I can't speak.' Only their lips moved.
Mom turned toward Mina. "I'll stay here. Shall you take just one step?" "Just one?" Mina looked up.
One foot came out from behind Mom. An anklet flashed. Biju noticed first. "Wow, shiny!" Biju smiled.
"One Step Out from Behind Mom!" Mina took a second step. Half their face showed now. "I... I'm Mina." The voice was very small.
Biju spun a wooden top on the soil. Mina came right out. "I'd like a turn!"
They sat side by side and spun it again and again. Mina's heart no longer pounded. "Our house is beside that big tree."
Mina showed Biju an open hand. "Let's play at my house next time. Bring the top!"
Mom hugged Mina. Over her shoulder, Mina waved to Biju. "Let's play again tomorrow!"
